lines.text: The one who calls himself a Jew relies on the law and boasts in God.
The teacher is asked whether he steals, and whether the one who forbids adultery commits adultery.
Circumcision has value if you offer a sacrifice, and the uncircumcised man who keeps the law will condemn the lawbreaker.
A man is a Jew inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit.
